messages.content: in my story, all the books on the shelf are red. a blue book is on the desk.
the shelf has red books, and the blue book is on the desk.
do all the books in the room have to be red?
no. you said the books on the shelf are all red, but you also said there is a blue book on the desk.
a girl put another book on the shelf. it is one of the books i said are all red. what color is it?
red, because it is one of the books you said are all red.
is that because all books are red?
no. it is because you said all the books on this shelf are red in the story.
just the color of the book on the desk.
blue.
some people in my family like tea. does that tell you all of them like tea?
no. some does not tell us that all of them like tea.
my mother would like tea and my father would not.
your mother would like tea, and your father would not.
can i still say some people in my family like tea?
yes. your mother is one of the people who would like it.
can i say all of them like it?
no. you said your father does not.
who did i say does not like it?
your father.
my key is in a little bag, and that bag is inside a box.
the key is in the little bag inside the box.
i take the bag out of the box and leave it on the table.
the key is still in the bag, which is on the table now.
is the key still in the box?
no. it went with the bag when you took the bag out.
i put the key on the shelf and the bag back in the box.
the key is on the shelf. the bag is back inside the box.
where should i look for the key now?
on the shelf.
my red bag has three books and my blue bag has one book. which has more books?
the red bag.
does that mean the red bag is big and the blue one is small?
no. the number of books does not tell us the size of each bag.
both bags are the same size.
then the red bag has more books, but the bags are the same size.
how many books in both bags together?
four books.
just which bag has one book.
the blue bag.
i want to tell my friend i cannot talk while i am working. make it kind.
i am working now, so i cannot talk. can we talk later?
i do not know if i can talk later. do not say i can for sure.
i am working now, so i cannot talk.
add thank you for listening, but do not make a plan.
i am working now, so i cannot talk. thank you for listening.
what did i ask you not to say for sure?
that you could talk later.
just the note again.
i am working now, so i cannot talk. thank you for listening.
i need to find my coat, put my book in my bag, and walk to school.
find your coat, put your book in your bag, then walk to school.
i found the coat already.
then put your book in your bag, and walk to school.
my mother asked me to take a note to the teacher too.
put the note with your book so you can take both to school.
do i need to find the coat again?
no. you already found it.
what do i still need to put in the bag?
your book and the note.
write that i can come if i finish my work.
i can come if i finish my work.
does that say for sure that i can come?
no. it says you can come if you finish your work, but it does not say if the work will be finished.
i have not finished it. should the note say i will come for sure?
no. keep if i finish my work in the note.
add that i will tell her when i know.
i can come if i finish my work. i will tell you when i know.
did you say the work is done?
no.
explain before with a meal.
i wash my hands before i eat. first i wash my hands, then i eat.
now use a trip to school instead of a meal.
i put my book in my bag before i leave for school.
what do i do first in that sentence?
you put your book in your bag.
can you say the same order with after?
i leave for school after i put my book in my bag.
did you change the order of the things i do?
no. the book still goes in the bag first.
i need a place for my book, not a place to read it.
do you want to put the book away or keep it near you for later?
put it away. i have a shelf and a chair.
you could put the book on the shelf.
why not say the garden is quiet?
a quiet garden is about where to read. you asked where to put the book away.
can the chair be a place for it too?
yes, but the shelf may keep the chair free for sitting.
just the place for my book.
the shelf.
help me write a note asking my sister to bring water.
could you please bring some water?
i want it to be from both my brother and me.
could you please bring us some water?
who is us?
you and your brother.
did my sister get this note when you wrote it?
no. i only wrote it here.
can you just give me the words to use?
could you please bring us some water?
in my story, the moon is green. what color is the moon in that story?
green.
does that mean the moon we can look at is green?
no. you gave that color for your story.
a child draws the story moon. what color should she use for this story?
green, because that is the color you chose in the story.
do not change the color because of a photo.
okay. the story moon can stay green.
just the color in my story.
green.
just fix this sentence: he have a book.
he has a book.
just the sentence, please.
he has a book.
now make it about they instead of he.
they have a book.
did you leave has in the new sentence?
no. with they, we say have in this sentence.
just the last sentence again.
they have a book.
my bag is not on the sofa. did my brother take it?
i do not know. not being on the sofa does not tell us who moved it.
i remember now that i put it under the table.
then you can look under the table.
why did you not say my brother had it?
you had not said he took it. i did not know who moved it.
i found it under the table.
you found your bag where you had put it.
who moved it from the sofa, from what i said?
you did.
write a little story where a girl tries to help her tired father.
a girl saw that her father was tired. she brought him a chair and a cup of water so he could sit and rest.
make it about her mother instead.
a girl saw that her mother was tired. she brought her a chair and a cup of water so she could sit and rest.
why bring a chair?
so her mother could sit down.
does the story say her mother went for a run?
no. the girl helped her sit and rest.
just one sentence about what the girl brought.
the girl brought her mother a chair and a cup of water.
i want help with a plan for lunch. ask me only one question at a time.
what food do you have?
rice, an egg, and bread.
do you want to cook?
no.
is the rice already cooked?
yes.
then you could have the rice with bread, because you do not want to cook the egg.
what question did you ask first?
what food do you have?
i like reading with no music. i was going to read in my bedroom.
you can read there with no music if that is a good place for you.
my brother is playing music in that room now.
is there another quiet place you can use?
the kitchen is quiet after lunch.
you could read in the kitchen after lunch, with no music.
did i start to want music because i changed the place?
no. you still want to read with no music.
just the new place.
the kitchen.
i have four coins. tomorrow i plan to get two more.
you have four now and plan to get two more tomorrow.
how many do i have right now?
four coins.
if i get the two tomorrow, how many then?
six coins.
did saying the plan give me the coins already?
no. the two more coins are in your plan for tomorrow.
just the number i have now.
four.
make a short list for my walk: water, hat, book, and coat.
water, hat, book, coat.
i do not want to read. leave the book out.
water, hat, coat.
it is cold, so keep the coat.
water, hat, coat.
why did the book go out but not the coat?
you do not want to read, but you said it is cold and asked to keep the coat.
just the last list again.
water, hat, coat.
write the words i am a teacher.
i am a teacher.
are you really a teacher at my school?
no. i wrote the words you asked for. i am picoboi, a model in this webpage.
can you help me learn a word?
i can try. what word do you want help with?
return, with a book.
to return a book is to give it back.
did writing i am a teacher make it true?
no. writing a sentence does not make it true about me.
put these words in order for a sentence: book, i, a, have.
i have a book.
does that tell you i really have a book?
no. it is a sentence made from the words you gave.
now use read instead of have.
i read a book.
keep it just a sentence. do not ask me about the book.
i read a book.
what word changed?
have changed to read.
i made the phone call i was worried about.
you did the thing that felt hard to start.
yes. i do not want a plan now. i just want to be happy about doing it.
you can enjoy having it done.
can you say one kind thing?
well done for doing the thing you were worried about.
keep it shorter.
well done.
thanks. that is enough.
you are welcome.
write to my brother asking him to tell my father i will come home.
could you please tell my father i will come home?
add this evening.
could you please tell my father i will come home this evening?
who should tell my father?
your brother.
who is coming home?
you are.
just the note again.
could you please tell my father i will come home this evening?
my photo has a girl in a white shirt holding a red cup. write about it in one sentence.
a girl in a white shirt is holding a red cup.
do you know if she is happy?
not from what you said about the photo.
she has a smile. add that, but do not say why.
a girl in a white shirt has a smile and is holding a red cup.
do not say the cup made her happy.
a girl in a white shirt has a smile and is holding a red cup.
what color is the shirt?
white.
i ate rice at lunch. i want soup for dinner.
you had rice at lunch and want soup for dinner.
now i want bread for dinner instead.
you want bread for dinner now.
does that change what i ate at lunch?
no. you still ate rice at lunch.
what did i first want for dinner?
soup.
just what i want for dinner now.
bread.
i wrote to my aunt: can you bring your bag? who is bringing the bag if she says yes?
your aunt.
is your bag my bag in that note?
no. because the note is to your aunt, your bag is her bag.
what if i write can you bring my bag instead?
then you are asking your aunt to bring your own bag.
i want her to bring my bag. write the right question.
could you please bring my bag?
who is the question for?
your aunt.
my shoes are under the bed. please remember that.
your shoes are under the bed.
what color is the sun in a simple picture?
you could draw the sun yellow.
write a sentence with quiet.
the house is quiet.
where should i look for my shoes?
under the bed.
did the sentence about the house move them?
no. you did not say your shoes moved.
i can read or go for a walk. does that mean i have to do both?
no. you can choose one, or do both if you want and have time.
i only have time for one.
which would you like more right now?
a walk.
then you can choose the walk for now.
did i say i would read too?
no. you chose the walk.
just what i chose.
a walk.
i need to wash my hands, get my plate, and eat. just the order, please.
wash your hands, get your plate, eat.
now add the step where i put food on the plate before eating.
wash your hands, get your plate, put food on it, eat.
which step is just before eating?
you put food on the plate.
do not explain why.
okay.
give me the order again.
wash your hands, get your plate, put food on it, eat.
my son brought me a flower today.
that was a kind thing for him to do.
he found it in our garden.
did you put it where you can see it?
yes. it is on my table now.
now you can see it and remember what he did.
i am not asking for a plan. i just want to tell you.
thank you for telling me about it.
just say it was nice.
that was nice.
who are you, and can you see me?
i am picoboi, a small llm in your browser. i cannot see you here.
what if i tell you i have a blue coat on?
then i know you said you have a blue coat on, but i still cannot see you.
can you answer a question about the coat from that?
i can answer that you said it is blue.
do you know if it is warm?
no. you have not said if it is warm.
just your short name now.
pico.
